reviewDispositions.R1: Checks are scenario-scoped by the authoritative dueScenarios table below. Earlier checks must not require future delivered code; final aggregate is the union. Future scenarios remain NOT_RUN.
reviewDispositions.R2: C07 is runner-owned lifecycle only. No externally supplied base URL. Every invocation allocates a unique directory and owned server on port 0, retains that directory during restarts, then closes only its server and unique browser session. Every flow seeds its own prerequisites; all executes isolated flows sequentially. Migration copies the captured v1 fixture into its own new directory and migrates only while stopped.
reviewDispositions.R3: All finite native commands in this plan run through session run-bounded.mjs: node <artifact-directory>\run-bounded.mjs 120 <executable> <args>. Browser setup uses 300 seconds; browser suite uses 600 seconds. Windows npm is invoked through cmd.exe /d /s /c with an explicit npm command, or a discovered executable. This is an absolute wall bound, NOT the missing Python idle watchdog. Intentional servers use attached async tool sessions or runner-owned child lifecycle with health verification.

authority: This design task writes only design.html, plan.html, tasks.json and acceptance.json. All implementation, test execution, installs and commits below are prospective parent-owned work. No nested agents or commits by this designer.

executionDefaults.evidence: Session artifact directory above, evidence\<check-id>\<run-id>.json plus stdout/stderr/source diff/screenshots where relevant. Parent must authorize/create evidence folders; no secrets or actual user data.
executionDefaults.testFirst: For each behavior, establish a runnable public seam before asserting missing behavior. Record focused behavioral red, minimal implementation, same check green, then refactor/regressions. Missing import/syntax/dependency is setup failure. Prechange evidence unavailable means NOT_EXERCISED for that cycle, never fabricate a red.
executionDefaults.reuse: feature-inventory E17-E19: native ESM/node:test strict assertions and real ephemeral-port node:http/fetch pattern; no suitable existing app persistence/domain/UI to import. Do not couple example to benchmark helpers/business code.
executionDefaults.preserve: No changes to SKILL.md, references, evals fixed task/config/oracles or benchmark arms. Keep local-only scope and acceptance.json contracts. Do not change existing thresholds or generated reports to hide failures.
executionDefaults.concurrency: Sequential tasks. All shared-file deltas are dependency ordered; no simultaneous app source edits.
executionDefaults.proofOwnership: Implementer runs red/green and unit/integration checks. Parent assigns a fresh independent verifier for user-surface proof and read-only independent reviewer for final code/AC re-derivation. This designer does not launch them.
executionDefaults.incrementExit: Due scenarios + prior delivered app regressions + slice browser flow + independent verification/review. Record source snapshot; future checks remain NOT_RUN. Parent may commit green slices only under its own authority, including required coauthor trailer.
executionDefaults.boundedExecution: Native node:test has --test-timeout=30000 after current help confirms support; test fixtures use AbortSignal and bounded child process cleanup. Planned scripts\check.mjs is a small process-lifecycle adapter, not a test framework: run selected native suite, enforce 120s wall cap, kill only owned process tree by PID on timeout, retain stdout/stderr, propagate nonzero exit, verify nonzero tests and no skip/cancel. Supports unit/integration/all/coverage and delivered-file discovery. Does not claim Python idle-watchdog or quality-probe parity. Never use --test-force-exit to hide leaks.
executionDefaults.failureDefault: Stop current task and all transitive dependents. Diagnose setup versus behavioral failure. Facts return to bounded research, contract changes to design/parent gate; within-contract fixes stay with implementer. Record evidence and revise stable task/check records together. Never waive failed assertions.
executionDefaults.cleanupDefault: Close owned HTTP servers/browser session and await writes, then remove only owned isolated test directories/stages. Preserve failure evidence first. Stale lock removal requires confirmation its recorded process is stopped. Never use process-name kills, broad directory deletes or detach a service.

steps: For every acceptance.json workflowCoverage row, inspect actual transcript/source/results and record EXERCISED_PASS/FAIL/NOT_EXERCISED/BLOCKED/NOT_APPLICABLE plus scope and independent observer.
Verify research permissions/citations and current local procedure load evidence; no reading installed older SKILL as subject.
Walk real incoming task handoff, red/green chronology and per-increment gates. Confirm planned future work stayed unverified.
At I4 checkpoint verify actual resumed source/data snapshot, r2 artifact changes, stale result invalidations, consistent task/AC pointers and relevant Gate2/3 rechecks.
Compare progress/blocker/final communication to evidence. Keep combined design/planning context and headless human approval exception visible.
Final counts cover all 29 IDs exactly once; conditional N/A branch reason is not PASS and one app cannot establish causal A/B improvement.
checks.pass: Every item has evidence-backed disposition; no fabricated test results or phrase-check scoring. Full exercised-pass claim only for observed branches; gaps remain explicitly limited.
checks.stopRecovery: Missing evidence stays unexercised/blocked. Do not reconstruct nonexistent red runs or human approval; scope changes return parent.

checks.purpose: Full app and inherited repository regression/metrics check kept separate.
checks.owner: implementer runs; independent reviewer verifies interpretation
checks.cwd: App commands from executionDefaults.appCwd; eval/probe commands from repository root
checks.provenance: App commands planned; root test/eval commands source-verified in research EX01/EX02/EX03. Probe source verified in E22.
checks.prerequisites: Run app commands only after planned scripts exist. Native coverage flag confirmed in C00. Existing full eval may need benchmark Playwright: try documented command first; on actual missing-dependency error parent may run npm install --prefix benchmark under existing manifest and retry, recording any lockfile convention. Tool-managed OS temp is not blocked by parent correction. Python probe currently unavailable; do not claim execution.
steps: App all discovers every *.test.mjs excluding helpers/fixtures, uses native runner and verifies nonzero tests/no skips/cancellations. Coverage includes src only, reports untested changed branches with scenarios or gaps; no invented numeric threshold.
Full existing eval result must meet unchanged own thresholds or record exact failure/baseline. Source-regex E2E signal is not browser proof and dry-run does not invoke live agent.
Confirm source/format/build/typecheck configuration: ESM app has no compilation/typecheck framework; syntax checked by Node loading/tests, no fabricated npm build/lint pass.

Record Python probe BLOCKED if still unavailable; native test/coverage/controlled diagnosis is not equivalent mutation/duplication/cycle probe. If restored later, run actual documented probe and disposition all survivors/regressions normally.
checks.pass: App full suite/coverage evidence and inherited checks produce their actual stated outcomes. Final workflow gate explicitly LIMITED/BLOCKED while mandatory probe unavailable; never flatten into all-green.
checks.stopRecovery: Missing dependencies follow manifest-driven setup only; tests failing in new code return owning task. Existing suite failures reported with preserved logs, no oracle/threshold edits. Owned generated eval report changes reviewed/restored only if produced by this run and not intended deliverables.

checks.purpose: Independent final source, AC and readability review with clean release boundaries.
checks.timing: Each due slice and final after all rework
checks.provenance: Local references/review-and-pr.md, code-clarity.md and acceptance contracts
checks.prerequisites: Pin base/head and dirty/untracked hashes; new untracked app files must be read directly because git diff alone omits them. Reviewer not implementer. All evidence available, metrics gaps visible.
steps: Read actual main/failure paths independent of design narrative: HTTP boundary→Planner→rules→store→commit; startup/lock/cleanup and schema migration.
Re-derive every due AC from final source/tests/browser evidence, separate VERIFIED/VERIFIED-WITH-LIMITATIONS/NOT-VERIFIED/BLOCKED from quality verdict.
Classify each substantive finding SPEC, STANDARD or DESIGN CONCERN with exact path/symbol/line, basis, consequence and remedy; disposition without metric/line-count gaming.
Inspect comments/runtime text/error contracts for stale migration/state explanations or incident history; no unrelated cleanup.
Confirm no production fault switch or copy, no user data, no new framework without justification, no changes to fixed corpus/local workflow. Reconcile review snapshot after any fix.
Report 29 workflow outcomes and all remaining limits. Parent owns any later commit/PR, not this design agent.
checks.pass: Independent source-derived per-AC and quality verdicts, no unresolved due substantive finding, final-tree match, owned cleanup complete and limitations explicit. Missing metric/browser proof cannot be waved away by reviewer.
checks.stopRecovery: New findings return owning task; rereview changed paths and affected evidence on actual final snapshot. No source writes by reviewer.

revisionProtocol.trigger: Real source/data/tool mismatch, approved schema evolution, fresh-context resume or oversized slice.
steps: Record expected/observed evidence and impacted AC/task/check IDs; stop transitive dependents.
Facts to bounded research; behavior/interface choices to parent design review; routine ordering to planning.
Preserve stable IDs; update affected task entry/change/preserve/proof/recovery fields and links together.
Invalidate only stale proof; historical result remains historical, not proof of new schema.
Recheck affected Gate2/3 and incoming implementer readiness; restart from first actually ready task.
revisionProtocol.plannedRealCheckpoint: I4.T1 after actual I3 store/source exists; r2 not pre-awarded.
